[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row, San Antonio II, matches this operators own SAT2 site code. This exact correspondence is directly confirmed by an UPSTACK marketplace listing titled CyrusOne San Antonio II Data Center and by this registrys own previously stored CyrusOne website URL for this row, which used the same san-antonio-texas-ii naming before returning a 404 error on a fresh fetch this session. A datacentermap listing dedicated to SAT2, fetched fresh this session, gives 9554 Westover Hills Boulevard, San Antonio, Texas 78251 as the street address. The operators own current page for this campus, also fetched fresh this session, groups SAT2 through SAT4 together as one named Data Center Campus without individual street addresses.
